name: Driving licence address change
description: Apply to the Licensing Authority for change of address in the driving licence using CMVR Form 2, online through Sarathi (Services on Driving License > Change of Address) or at the RTO, with proof of the new address.
description_hi: CMVR फ़ॉर्म 2 के माध्यम से लाइसेंसिंग प्राधिकरण को ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस में पता परिवर्तन के लिए आवेदन करें — सारथी पर ऑनलाइन (Services on Driving License > Change of Address) या RTO में, नए पते के प्रमाण के साथ।
authority: State Transport Department / Licensing Authority (Parivahan Sewa, MoRTH)
verification_notes: The Form 2 annexure gives a combined 'Proof of Address and Age' list. Only the entries that are evidently address documents are modelled (Aadhaar card, electoral roll, life insurance policy, passport); age-only documents are omitted. States may specify other documents and procedures, and fees vary by state.

requirements.name: Existing driving licence
requirements.description: Form 2 asks for particulars of the existing licence; the online service starts from the DL number.

requirements.name: Proof of new address (any one)
requirements.description: Address proof must be enclosed for a change of address.
requirements.notes: Source lists these under 'Proof of Address and Age'. Your State Government may accept other documents.

requirements.name: Passport-size photograph
requirements.condition: Listed under 'Other documents to be enclosed or uploaded if applicable'.
